title: Checkpoint preservation of halting and output
statement: Let $M$ be a machine in code normal form, let $\alpha$ be a finite bit string, and let $x$ be a finite input string. For any configuration of $M$ on input $x$ and any natural-number table cursor, the corresponding interpreter checkpoint is halted if and only if the source configuration is halted, and its output equals the source configuration’s output.
hypotheses_covered: A machine in code normal form $M$
A source configuration on some finite input $x$
replaced:
The interpreter checkpoint representing a source configuration of a coded
machine is halted exactly when the source configuration is halted, and its
accumulated output equals the source's accumulated output.
